title: Unbeatable Sagrada Familia Tour!
text: We had a private tour of Sagrada Familia with Cristina and it was amazing. In advance of arriving and throughout the tour, Cristina was easy to communicate with, responsive, and accommodating. Her knowledge, delivery, and interaction with our family made Sagrada Familia come to life and kept us engaged. I would definitely book this tour or any tour she gives next time we are in Barcelona.
author: Go23083840322

title: Best tour guide we've had anywhere
text: Cristina was an incredbile guide.  Once I emailed her, she was very commiunicative via email.  She was very clear when she would meet us at our hotel and didn't try to upsell anything.  On the tour, she kept it moving, but respected our time and answered questions without rush and gave us space to take some pictures.  It was just my wife and I on the Gaudi Tour - and that was amazing.  Skipping the lines was very helpful.  And she told the taxi drivers where to go.  Easily the best tour guide we've had!  My wife misses her and wishes she could go to more things with her in the future.
author: E5626KNrichardh

title: Excellent Guide, Excellent Private Tour
text: With limited time in Barcelona, we decided to book a1/2 day private highlights tour of the city through O My Guide! Barcelona. Our guide, Cristina, was fantastic. She provided a wealth of information on the city, its history, architecture, art and culture while guiding us to the “must see” places. We saw and learned a lot more than we could have done on our own for sure. Well worth the time and money! Highly recommend.
author: AnneP706

title: Best Barcelona Tour Guide
text: Cristina was AMAZING! She had so much knowledge of the city and was a pleasure to be around. She tailors the tours to whatever you want and gives great recommendations for restaurants, shops and other things to do. Highly recommend!
author: BVays

title: Sagrada Familia Tour
text: Cristina is amazing! We did the Sagrada Familia tour with her and had an amazing experience. She is extremely knowledgeable and we had the best time. 10/10!!
author: americad22

title: The best tour guide
text: Cristina is an amazing guide and person.  Her experience and wonderful personality made my family have a fantastic first day of sight seeing in Barcelona.  She had helpful tips, made us reservations, and assisted with learning about the wonderful culture.
author: 395geoffe

title: Amazing tour! Cristina was the best.
text: My family and I did the “best of Gaudi” tour with Cristina. This was a huge highlight of our trip. She was incredibly knowledgeable, helpful, kind, and so much fun! I would recommend Cristina to anyone traveling to Barcelona. Any questions we had about the sights she had in depth answers and you can tell she is truly passionate. We absolutely loved the Sagrada Familia and felt like if we toured it without her, it wouldn’t have been the same at all and would not have gotten the best information. title: Barcelona = Cristina Belenguer
text:
Cristina is way more than just a guide. She has a sweet, yet professional personality, takes care of everything one needs (reservations, logistics, etc) and has insights about Barcelona that most guides (or even agencies) would not have.
I have traveled extensively and visited many cities in the world with many guides but Cristina is on a whole different level.

Barcelona = Cristina Belenguer

I can’t wait to go back and visit the city with her again
